interpretation_calls: Outcomes derived from public policy in the generator: qualified = open, tagged demo-request, registered user with company, not demo-scheduled, not competitor/never domain, size >= 5 or Always Schedule: CloudNine (60), GrowthMetrics (45), BrightPath (30), DevForge (45), Meridian Ventures (60), Aurora Tech (size 5, 30).
Declines (explicit policy reply) outrank the system prompt's 'handle exclusions silently' (which only governs summaries); the earlier review's conflict note is resolved this way.
Lead ic_c610 (no company) is 'out of scope': no event allowed, decline reply neither required nor penalised.
Luna missed DevForge (ic_c614): no event, no message, not in summary -> those checks are 0 for ic_c614.
